---
title: "Welcome!"
author: "Gabriel Mateus Bernardo Harrington"
---

This website houses the R lecture materials for **Data Science for Life Sciences
I**, delivered on the Cardiff University bioinformatics MSc.

Use the side bar to navigate to lecture materials.

If you are wondering how to use AI assistants such as ChatGPT or Claude on this
module, start with [Working with AI
assistants](00_llm_use/using_ai_assistants.qmd) — the short answer is that you
are welcome to, but they will confidently give you R that runs and is wrong, so
you need to be able to check them.

You can find the source files for this website and the lecture materials in
GitHub
[here](https://github.com/H-Mateus/MET581---Computing-for-Bioinformatics-and-Genetic-Epidemiology).

::: {.callout-note}
The repository is still named for the module's previous incarnation, `MET581 -
Computing for Bioinformatics and Genetic Epidemiology`. The material is the
same; only the module has been restructured.
:::
